title: Activation Fee Credit Against a Parking License Early Cancellation Fee
content:
Notes to the Parking License schedule of charges: the activation fee a resident paid when the license started is credited against an early cancellation fee once the license has been held long enough.

## Note

When the license has been held at least 120 days, the activation credit is the activation fees posted on the license; when it has been held at least 60 but fewer than 120 days, the activation credit is 0.5 of the activation fees posted on the license; in every other case there is no activation credit.

The activation credit is subtracted from the fee months times the fee base as multiplied, the result is never below zero, and it is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

- **Days held** run from the license's start date to the notice date.
- **Activation fees posted** are all activation fee lines on the license's ledger, whatever their date.

## Credit by days held

| Days held | Activation credit |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | the whole of the activation fees posted |
| 60 to 119 | 0.5 (half) of the activation fees posted |
| fewer than 60 | none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical: activation fees posted of $25.00)

| Fee before the credit | Days held | Activation credit | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| $58.50 | 130 | $25.00 | $33.50 |
| $58.50 | 120 | $25.00 | $33.50 |
| $58.50 | 119 | $12.50 | $46.00 |
| $58.50 | 59 | none | $58.50 |
| $20.00 | 150 | $25.00 | $0.00 (never below zero) |
